name: miuix-skills
description: Miuix 0.9.5-beta01 skills for source-verified library contracts, greenfield app shells, and page composition.

interface.longDescription: Two complementary skills for Miuix Compose UI: one verifies library contracts against pinned source, and one guides complete page and greenfield app-shell composition, including pager-backed destinations, route boundaries, and floating navigation.
defaultPrompt: Verify the exact Miuix API and module for this component.
Design this Miuix page from its skeleton and ownership boundaries.
Build a complete greenfield Miuix app shell with peer pages, typed routes, and a floating bottom navigation bar.
